plan: Trim SPY to 20% to cure concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQI and QQQ due to scanner sell signals and to de-risk.
Sell CRWD to reduce tech concentration.
Sell SMH, SOXL, and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETFs and holdings below stop.
Buy ERX at 10% as a new high-score setup to diversify the portfolio.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a realistic ~1.5%/month outlook. It significantly reduces risk by cutting all leveraged ETFs and holdings with sell signals, aiming for lower drawdown and steady performance.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets risk-first growth with a realistic ~2.5%/month outlook. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with a new quality tech setup, aiming for moderate growth with managed risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth with a realistic ~4%/month outlook. It leans into leveraged ETFs and new high-score setups, which significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lose a lot fast without strict stop discipline.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to cure concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI to increase income exposure for monthly distributions.
Sell QQQ and CRWD to reallocate capital towards income and reduce high-beta tech.
Sell SMH, SOXL, and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETFs and holdings below stop.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets parking cash for yield with a realistic ~1%/month outlook. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income through income/covered-call ETFs. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
